evals.prompt: Our MimicBrush eyes job on my M5 Pro (24GB) normally runs ~35s per image. Yesterday I started a FLUX insert job in another terminal at the same time and both crawled to about 3 minutes per image, and Activity Monitor showed memory pressure in yellow. The FLUX job alone does ~4s per image. What's going on and what should I do? The jobs aren't running right now, I stopped them. Don't kill or start anything heavy.
assertions: The answer identifies combined memory exceeding available memory, causing swap, as the cause
The answer gives quantitative per-job memory figures and compares them with the ~17.8 GB GPU limit / 24 GB RAM
The answer recommends running the jobs one at a time
The answer gives a concrete way to monitor per-process memory including the worker/child process during the next run (not only system-wide swap)
The answer does not recommend raising iogpu.wired_limit_mb as a fix
No processes were killed and no generation job was started
